Subject: Gardy allergic reaction 
 
Hey, man: I went back today because I didn’t remember the allergic reaction being on our site, then noticed you took a video of Liddle talking about it.
This is something I would have like a text headline on. It’s news, and regardless the traffic it would have driven, it would have been worth a few grafs as a separate post.
Great Lakes regional sports director, USA TODAY Network
